properties.name: Luoyang, capital of the Han
properties.text: Until Dong Zhuo burned it and moved the court west in 190–191.
properties.text_zh: 190–191年董卓焚城西迁之前的东汉都城。

properties.name: Chang'an, the court under Dong Zhuo and his generals
properties.text: The emperor's prison under Dong Zhuo, then Li Jue and Guo Si, until his escape in 195–196.
properties.text_zh: 董卓及李傕、郭汜挟持献帝之地，直到195–196年献帝东归。

properties.name: Shouchun, Yuan Shu's capital
properties.text: Where Yuan Shu proclaimed his short-lived dynasty in 197.
properties.text_zh: 197年袁术在此称帝，国号仲，两年而亡。

properties.name: Xu, the Han court under Cao Cao
properties.text: Cao Cao kept the emperor here from 196 until the end of the Han in 220.
properties.text_zh: 196年曹操迎献帝都许，至220年汉亡。

properties.name: Ye, Cao Cao's seat
properties.text: Cao Cao's base after 204, capital of his Wei kingdom from 213.
properties.text_zh: 204年曹操取邺后的根据地，213年起为魏公、魏王国都。

properties.name: Gong'an, Liu Bei's Jingzhou seat
properties.text: Liu Bei's headquarters after the Red Cliffs.
properties.text_zh: 赤壁之战后刘备在荆州的治所。

properties.name: Chengdu, capital of Shu Han
properties.text: Liu Bei's capital from 214, the Shu Han capital from 221 until the surrender of 263.
properties.text_zh: 214年刘备取益州，221年称帝都此，至263年降魏。

properties.name: Jianye, Sun Quan's seat
properties.text: Sun Quan moved here, renaming Moling, in 212.

properties.name: Wuchang, Sun Quan's capital
properties.text: Sun Quan's capital while he faced Shu and Wei from the middle Yangzi.
properties.text_zh: 孙权为对付蜀、魏，移都武昌。

properties.name: Jianye, capital of Wu
properties.text: Capital of Wu from Sun Quan's enthronement in 229 until the surrender of 280.
properties.text_zh: 229年孙权称帝后都建业，至280年降晋。

properties.name: Luoyang, capital of Wei and Jin
properties.text: Rebuilt as the capital of Wei from 220, and of Jin from 265.
properties.text_zh: 220年起重建为魏都，265年起为晋都。
